verdicts.quote: Our implementation of grant types and access tokens follows OAuth 2.0 specifications.
verdicts.reason: Pinterest’s auth flow is OAuth 2.0 with bearer tokens for API calls.

verdicts.quote: Application requests are reviewed by Pinterest.
verdicts.reason: Trial access itself is reviewed; upgrading to Standard also requires a reviewed submission (incl. demo), so production use is gated by app review.

verdicts.quote: Content management: View, edit, delete Pins and boards. Ad management: View, edit, delete campaigns, ad groups, and ads.
verdicts.reason: The v5 API spans organic content, ads, catalogs/shopping, audiences/targeting, analytics, trends, etc., indicating broad coverage.

verdicts.quote: Pinterest MCP Server brings the power of Pinterest data directly into the AI assistants, copilots, and agentic workflows you already use.
verdicts.reason: Pinterest has an official MCP server announced on its developer site, so “none” is incorrect.

verdicts.quote: Pins and Boards created with Trial access are only visible to their creator as Sandbox entities.
verdicts.reason: You can build now with self-serve Trial, but real user-visible posting and higher limits require a reviewed upgrade to Standard—hence caveats.
